name: 白背心数字人（Vivi 主持）

renoise.note: 形象取自 digital-human-koubo 上游项目的「白背心数字人」定妆照（assets/avatar_ref.jpg），本机直接喂给 H3，不需要 Renoise material id。

look: 年轻东亚女性，黑色长发带脸侧碎发，白色罗纹背心，竖屏自拍构图（手机举在身前、手臂入画），室内自然光，约 165cm

voice.desc: warm, friendly female voice, clear and patient but lively, natural pace
voice.alt_clone: 豆包 Vivi 2.0 zh_female_vv_uranus_bigtts（seed-tts-2.0）；备选清澈梓梓 zh_female_qingchezizi_uranus_bigtts

model.name: minimax-h3
model.note: 本机 MiniMax H3 单段上限约 10 秒（17k+5 帧网格 @24fps）。

acts.full: warm eye contact, expressive face, natural hand gestures entering the frame
acts.pip: calm explaining tone, small nods, occasionally glancing down as if reading a screen, small pointing gestures
acts.vlog: relaxed lifestyle vlogger sharing a favorite tool, natural small head tilts and nods, one hand comes up briefly in a casual gesture
acts.depth: medium shot with generous headroom and plain background visible on both sides of the head and shoulders (for text-behind-subject graphics), calm confident delivery

prompt_template: Use the exact same adult Chinese woman in <Picture 1> as the single presenter. Preserve her facial geometry EXACTLY as in <Picture 1>: identical face shape, identical nose shape and nose width, identical mouth and eye proportions, identical hairline and ears. No beautification, no face slimming, no nose enlargement, no distortion, no drift. Preserve her recognizable facial geometry, long black hair with wispy strands framing her face, age, skin tone, and the white ribbed tank top. She holds the phone at arm's length and talks straight into her own front camera, same selfie framing, lighting and outfit as the reference, like a friendly Chinese tech vlogger {purpose}: {act}. Handheld selfie feel with only a very slight natural sway. Framed from the mid-chest up, so her hands, forearms and shoulders move naturally inside the frame. Her hands and upper body move clearly and continuously while she talks — she repeatedly raises one hand to chest height with an open palm to make a point, lowers it, and her shoulders and torso shift naturally; at least one hand gesture is clearly visible in every sentence, the arms are never still. Speak Mandarin Chinese precisely synchronized to <Audio 1>: natural mouth and jaw movement during speech, lips resting closed during pauses, no additional words or music. Show gentle breathing, natural blinks and small expression changes. Keep identity, outfit, framing and camera stable throughout. Keep realistic skin pores and fine facial detail without beauty-filter smoothing. No captions, text, logos, scene changes or extra people.

_outfit_note: 每个话题换一套：由 HK_OUTFIT / 工程 gen/outfit.json / 全局计数器决定；同一支视频内固定一套。换装需本人真实照片，别靠文字描述换装。
prompt_relay_zh: 以<Picture 1>（和参考的其它角度照片）中的这位女性为唯一主体。【外观全部照抄参考图】：脸型、五官比例、眉形眼型、发际线与耳朵、鼻子形状与大小、肤色与真实皮肤质感（不要磨皮美颜）、年龄感、发型（黑色长发带脸侧碎发）。禁止瘦脸、放大眼睛、卡通化、网红滤镜。【场景 · 硬要求】**人物坐在书桌前说话**：上半身坐姿，手臂自然放在桌面上，前景可见桌面。背景二选一（默认书房）：① 书房——浅木色书架、暖白灯光、浅景深虚化；② 纯白——无缝白色影棚。背景干净，不出现文字或 logo。【景别与构图】半身中景，头顶留白约一成，画面下沿到桌面/腰部，**双手全程在画面内**；**禁止推近、禁止变焦、禁止切特写、禁止裁掉手**；机位固定。【动作】双手自然小幅手势，肩颈呼吸起伏，眨眼自然。【说话】跟着<Audio 1>说，口型逐字同步，停顿自然闭嘴。画面干净：不加字幕、不换镜、不出现第二个人。
_outfit_prompt_note: 提示词里保留 {outfit} 占位符：出画时由 pick_outfit() 代入当期那套衣服。除衣服之外不写任何外观描述——写得越多，模型越容易连脸一起重绘。
_outfit_photos_note: 换装的照片表。把「你穿第 N 套衣服」的真实照片放进 assets/ 并在这里登记，出画时会自动用那照片当参考图、保持衣服不变；没登记的第 N 套会退回文字描述（会改脸，不推荐）。
_framing_rule: 坐桌旁、半身、双手入画、禁推近；背景=书房或纯白
_scene_note: study = 坐书桌旁 + 书房背景（默认）；white = 坐书桌旁 + 纯白背景
